name: rnqp-tests-harness
description: Minimal consumer-shaped package for the QueuePlayer XCTest harness. Lists only the native deps that CocoaPods' use_react_native! + RN codegen walk during pod install (react-native + react-native-nitro-modules). The tests-harness/node_modules symlink points at the library's real node_modules so these resolve without a separate npm install.
